item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q014_paper_example_reclassification_pa1492","answer":"In SCOP 1.69, PA1492 (1t1j; d1t1ja_, c.137.1.1) and nucleoside 2-deoxyribosyltransferase (1f8y; d1f8ya_, c.23.14.1) shared only the broad alpha/beta class c: PA1492 had its own c.137 fold, superfamily, and family, whereas 1f8y belonged to the flavodoxin-like fold c.23 and N-deoxyribosyltransferase superfamily c.23.14. Thus SCOP 1.69 did not assert homology between them. In the current public SCOPe release 2.08, PA1492’s biological domain (d1t1ja1, residues 1–118) is reclassified as c.23.14.2: it now shares the flavodoxin-like fold c.23 and N-(deoxy)ribosyltransferase-like superfamily c.23.14 with 1f8y, while remaining in a separate PA1492 family (.2 versus the enzyme’s .1). The change therefore upgrades the relationship from same class/different folds to superfamily-level probable common ancestry, not same-family equivalence. It does not establish that PA1492 catalyzes nucleoside 2-deoxyribosyltransferase chemistry or justify transferring 1f8y’s ligand specificity, catalytic residues, or detailed active-site annotation without independent sequence, structural, and biochemical evidence. 1f8y can be a superfamily/fold-level comparison or modeling template, but family-specific regions require validation. Chain B has the corresponding same classifications, so choosing chain A as the representative does not alter the conclusion.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope__get_scop_service_info — /api/v1/; /api/v1/releases/current","mcp__scope__get_scop_pdb_entry — /api/v1/releases/1.69/pdb/1t1j/domains; /api/v1/releases/1.69/pdb/1f8y/domains; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1t1j/domains; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1f8y/domains","mcp__scope__get_scop_domains — /api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1t1ja_; /api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1t1ja_/parents; /api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1f8ya_; /api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1f8ya_/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1t1ja1; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1t1ja1/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1t1ja1/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1f8ya_; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1f8ya_/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1f8ya_/homology"]}]}
